title: Study
description: A runnable experiment definition: a validated control/treatment pair + a task + run metadata. Produced by the operator UI's publish action (which MUST be gated on the single-variable validator); consumed by the experiment runtime and the Cloudflare Worker. Full RoomSpec snapshots are embedded so a study is reproducible from this one document (determinism guardrail).

study_id.description: Stable study identifier (also the D1 primary key).

hypothesis.description: Optional plain-language hypothesis, e.g. 'higher ceilings improve divergent thinking'.

citation.description: Optional literature anchor (PROPOSAL.md section 2), e.g. 'Meyers-Levy & Zhu 2007'.

pair_id.description: MUST equal experiment.pair_id inside both embedded specs.

control_spec.description: FULL RoomSpec snapshot (validates against room_spec.schema.json; embedding keeps the study self-contained — a published study never dangles on a mutable reference).

treatment_spec.description: FULL RoomSpec snapshot of the treatment condition.

validation.description: The single-variable gate stamp. A study with ok=false MUST NOT be publishable (guardrail #2) — the publish gate enforces this, and the Worker re-checks server-side.

diff.description: The stimulus diff from validate_pair: {dotted.path: [control_value, treatment_value]}.

notes.description: Coupled-variable notes the researcher must account for.

validator.description: Implementation + version that stamped this, e.g. 'validate_pair.py@1.0' or 'PairGate.cs@1.0' (must be diff_vectors-conformant).

task.description: The behavioral task run in/after the rooms. v1 registry matches response_log.schema.json task_type.

config.description: Task parameters: for rating {prompt, scale_min, scale_max, per_condition:bool}; for choice {prompt, trials:int}. Kept open (additionalProperties allowed) — the runner validates per-type.

modality.description: The modality this study runs in (recorded per guardrail #3; one study = one modality — a cross-modality comparison is two studies).

counterbalance.description: Ordering policy metadata (recorded now, consumed by the runner).

status.description: draft = editable; published = frozen + runnable (validation.ok MUST be true); closed = no longer collecting.

created_by.description: Author identifier (cohort/student handle; auth is a later phase).
